title.zh: 【分析：币安黑客两天内经波场清洗约 2.42 亿美元资金】
title.en: 【分析：币安黑客两天内经波场清洗约 2.42 亿美元资金】

current_state.zh: Two days after the Binance hack, attackers have laundered about $242M through Tron — roughly $194M of it moved off-chain/off-Tron via bridges and swap services — with Tether's $378.7M USDT freeze leaving about $249M still movable and only $7.5M remaining on Tron.
